description: State of one run: stage reached, panel verdicts, scoreboard, files produced, cost. Pass brief=true for a short, regenerated-on-demand resume brief instead - what a returning session with fresh context needs to re-enter the run. Pass wait_seconds (1-30; use 25) to hold the call until another call finishes, the run stops running, or the time is up, and `progress` in the result lists what finished meanwhile. until='settled' holds across finished calls and returns only when the run stops running or the time is up. Pass since (the `progress.cursor` from the last call, or 0 for everything so far) to get only what is new.
name: run_status
